system.description:
GNOME

The distinction between fey whim, natural spirit and mortal superstition has become much easier for you to hear.
You gain Spirit Lore as a specialist skill.
When using Trace Possession or Interpret Haunt against a Fey creature, a natural spirit or an effect created by one, you may use Nature instead of Occultism. Use your Nature ranks to meet the action's Rank requirement.
You gain a +1-racial bonus to checks made in this way.

Prerequisites Nature 1 rank

Works automatically: Spirit Lore is added to your specialist skills; Nature offers Trace Possession and Interpret Haunt to you, and +1 racial is offered on them with the book's wording.

conditionals.label: Fey-Soul Listener
conditionals.scope: Trace Possession or Interpret Haunt against a Fey creature, a natural spirit or an effect one created
